items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: we had Monty Marsala on the clarinet--

ctx.x: Yeah - not even for the opening night--
No - no - we just rehearsed on the bandstand; Condon called the tunes and we all knew them and we played them, but I thought it was very funny on opening night, we had Monty Marsala on the clarinet--
